verdict.rationale: Pika documents several first-party ways to turn stills into motion. Pikaframes animates between two to five keyframe images, lip sync animates an uploaded image to audio, Motion Transfer animates a character photo from a reference clip, and a product image can become a video ad. None of these is a general single-image-to-video mode, and nothing documents that subject and composition are preserved. missing for 10: explicit single-still image-to-video generation, documented preservation of subject and composition, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved
